scope: One shared original3warmup prefix, then four COW-cloned native Rust children each complete the unchanged20 measured fixed-fixture battles. limits.memoryScope: Parent+four-child PSS plus orchestrator RSS; summed RSS separately overcounts shared COW pages.
limits.cgroupSafetyScope: Whole current cgroup memory.current; default stop threshold95% of memory.max. PSS remains process-specific and independently bounded.

gc.scope: Each child inherits the original warmup collection count and cadence position, then completes all20 measured source battles.

observer.scope: Orchestrator process CPU only during the native fork run; includes PSS/RSS/cgroup reads, not child CPU or prior hashing/linking.

cgroup.scope: Whole cgroup includes workers, observer and any unrelated concurrent processes; counters cannot identify a specific overhead source.

cgroupMemory.scope: Whole cgroup, including unrelated processes and file cache; independently enforced even when PSS polls are sparse.
